Organization Settings
Configure your organization's identity and preferences

Manage organization name, visibility, SSO domain auto-join, and AI provider settings. These settings apply to all members in your organization.

New users who sign in via Google or Microsoft SSO with a matching email domain will be automatically added to this organisation as members.

Organisation Members
Manage team access and permissions

Members have different roles: Viewers can read, Members can use tools, Admins manage credentials and settings, Owners control all features including member removal and vault password.

Sent Invitations

Invitations are sent with a unique token. Recipients can join your organization and be assigned a role. Pending invitations expire after 30 days.
